bullets.t: Partnering with founders to take mission-led ventures from concept to spinout, at the studio that has spun out nine so far.
Building an agentic delegation product for parents of children with SEND: deciding what agents can safely take off a parent's plate, and what has to stay with them.
Two-week sprints against the venture hypothesis, riskiest assumption first, prototypes in front of families early, and evals before anything acts on a family's behalf.
I keep building: prototypes for lawyers, researchers and nurses, and open-source tools for agent work.

roles.role: Head of AI Product & Deployment (promoted from Head of Operations)

awards.name: DfE AI Tutoring Pioneers
awards.note: Placed 2nd of eight picked from 53 bids

awards.name: Sifted 100
awards.note: Fastest-growing edtech in the UK and Ireland, 36th overall

awards.name: Digital Technology Leaders Award
awards.note: Diversity Initiative of the Year, with HSBC

bullets.t: Led six product engineers and a designer on an agentic Socratic tutor on Claude, each engineer owning a problem from prototype to production, and wrote 28% of the commits myself. It went from a 30-school beta into 850+ UK schools, with 47% of monthly users back every week.

Every release passed a golden set of past papers and official mark schemes: bare model 67%, retrieval 79%, our covered content 99%+. The gap was coverage, so we fixed the content. The DfE picked the tutor for its AI Tutoring Tools Pioneers Programme.

Red-teamed the core failure, a student talking the tutor into the answer, and open-coded hundreds of production traces into failure modes (sycophancy on "I don't know", inconsistency across modes, hallucinated marks). Both became a pass/fail LLM judge on every session, and the Socratic pass rate doubled in two weeks, from 33% to 65%.
Teacher-led schools hit 98.7% activation, more than six times the self-signup rate. Pre-built classes and a weekly teacher call became our rollout pattern.
Designated safeguarding lead. Shipped detection first, then cut false alarms to designated leads by 97% with zero missed disclosures, the condition a trust set before adoption.
With costs at 4.6x plan, found one model taking 44.5% of spend, routed by task, and pulled a 14x cheaper model after 7 of 8 complaints traced to it.
A four-agent monitoring fleet read every production trace overnight, replaced a planned ops hire and produced half the evidence in our company retro.

roles.photoAlt: The Zero Gravity team in the office, gathered round a sofa under the company sign

paras: Elliot is the ultimate startup operator — a genuine Swiss Army knife who has made an impact across customer success, operations and product at Zero Gravity.

He doesn't just understand what AI makes possible; he builds with it, experiments rapidly and ships. He now contributes as many PRs as some of our senior engineers, while bringing the customer insight and commercial judgement you would expect from a strong product leader.
If I were starting another business tomorrow, Elliot would be one of the first people I'd try to hire.
quote.name: Joe Seddon

roles.role: Head of Operations & Enterprise Partnerships (founding hire #4)

bullets.t: Scoped, sold and delivered paid programmes inside the early-careers hiring of HSBC, Morgan Stanley, KPMG, Ashurst, Accenture and Snap, owned the milestones and renewals, and doubled the size of those accounts.
ISO 27001 and 9001 in under six months as sole DPO, then through due diligence with HSBC, Morgan Stanley, KPMG and Mercedes-AMG F1, with sales cycles 30% shorter.
Grew the company from 4 people to around 30, and ran the revenue ops behind £1.5m ARR.
An AI assistant resolved 91% of conversations, so a dedicated support hire was no longer needed. CSAT 84%, NPS 80+.
Mentee-to-mentor conversion from 6% to 40%, keeping students on one platform from school to university.

bullets.t: Led the probate service between customers, legal specialists and the case team, inside SRA and FCA regulation.
Case-agent errors down 69% and case handling from two weeks to four days, through HMCTS, HMRC and bank integrations.
Fixed the input errors eating 30% of solicitor time, so two solicitors did the work of five.
NPS from 20 to 80+, and the vulnerable-customer framework the whole company adopted.
Day 1 was a WhatsApp group; day 10 was a four-sided marketplace in production.
303,000 meals in 100 days to 146 hospitals from 223 restaurants, 97% on time.
Set up NHS data-sharing agreements across 146 hospitals, under crisis conditions.
£1.8m raised, and a volunteer team grown from 6 to 120 with a hiring playbook other leads could run.
Built CX and crisis operations from nothing: no CRM, ticketing or supplier contracts.
NPS held above 90 through 400% year-on-year growth.
The US launch hit its 12-week plan on the day, and the international partner network tripled.
Hired and trained the first 15 ops staff, with a 100% safety record through the Sri Lanka attacks and COVID closures.
